card.name: The start of the word cations
card.fires_on: The first letter or two of "cations" right after divalent, trivalent, multivalent or polyvalent, in interaction and compatibility warnings. Also the "yc" inside polycarbonate.

modes.description: The "yc" part of polycarbonate in an incompatibility statement.
